decisions.scenario: Checking a Saturday evening train from Broxbourne to Cambridge

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'd like a train that leaves after 17:00 on Saturday.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Certainly. Where will you be departing from, and where are you going?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'll be leaving from Broxbourne and travelling to Cambridge.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are seven options. The first leaves at 17:32 and arrives at 18:32. Would you like me to book it?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'm not looking to book yet. Could I just have the train ID?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Of course. Train TR0811 leaves at 17:32 and arrives at 18:32. The journey takes 60 minutes and costs £14.32.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That's all I need today. Thank you. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You're welcome. Enjoy your trip.

decisions.scenario: Finding an expensive Indian restaurant in central Cambridge

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'm looking for an expensive Indian restaurant. Can you help?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Certainly. There are 14 options. Do you have a preferred area?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I need somewhere in the town centre.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are six Indian restaurants in the centre. I suggest Curry Queen.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That sounds good. Could I have the address and postcode?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Curry Queen is at 5 Jordans Yard, Bridge Street, City Centre, postcode CB2 1UG. Would you like me to book it?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: No, thank you. That's all I needed.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You're welcome. Please contact us again if you need a reservation.
